instruction: Show me the scores for Week 10 of the 2023 regular season.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to Week 10 scores for 2023 regular season. Similar complexity to original - navigation to a specific week's scores. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match to verify the URL structure with season (2023) and week (REG10).

Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) can extract the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL structure
Expected URL pattern 'https://www\.nfl\.com/scores/2023/REG10' accurately represents the target page for Week 10 of 2023 regular season
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree -> extract URL -> regex match against expected pattern
The regex pattern correctly captures: (1) NFL.com domain, (2) /scores/ path, (3) year 2023, (4) REG10 (regular season week 10)
No postconfig needed - URL can be verified after navigation completes
Verification is precise and unambiguous - only the correct URL will match the pattern
